description: Inspect retained county property observations or repeated owner-name groups. Choose property_records for address, parcel or owner-label search; choose owner_portfolios for unfiltered owner-name groups. Property records allow 1–250 rows and offsets through 1000000; portfolios allow 1–100 rows and no query, signal or offset. JSON preview only. Source labels do not establish identity, authority, debt, equity, distress, cash purchases or sale intent.

county.description: Explicit county name or slug within the selected state; no county is assumed.

format.description: Return a JSON preview. Downloadable CSV products require a separately reviewed purchase and verified delivery.

limit.description: Maximum returned rows: 1–250 property records (default 25), or 1–100 owner-name groups (default 20).

mode.description: Choose property_records to search retained property observations, or owner_portfolios for unfiltered repeated owner-name groups without pagination.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset for property_records mode, from 0 through 1000000; default 0. Omit for owner_portfolios.

q.description: Address, parcel or retained owner-name label to search in property_records mode. Omit or send an empty string to browse all retained property records.

signal.description: Optional assessment-observation filter for property_records mode. No notice or motivation signals are supported.

state.description: Explicit two-letter state code, such as TN or GA.

name: gisdb_search_records
